+10. Apply the actor decision order below. (a) First decide whether this clause
+    text explicitly expresses a behavior performer or norm bearer. A noun phrase

+    confirming the role, extract the smallest explicit noun phrase or
+    pronominal mention that expresses it. A pronoun it/they/this/these/such is a

+    pronoun exact span even when its reference is unresolved. If
+    this/these/such modifies a noun, extract the complete minimal noun phrase
+    instead of the determiner alone. (c) Then apply the reference, passive, and
+    coordination rules below. Do not convert an explicit actor mention with
+    unresolved reference into actors=[]; that is rule 17 uncertainty, not
+    absence.
